headline: DEATH ROW ⛓️ STAYED 🛑 for Christa Pike just 1 HOUR ⏰ before LETHAL 🍆 INJECTION
text:
Tennessee ⚖️ inmate Christa Pike's EXECUTION 💉 got HALTED 🛑 literally SIXTY ⏰ MINUTES before the needle 🪡 was gonna SLIDE 🛡️ into her VEIN 🩸 after DECADES 🕰️ on death row!! The 50-year-old 🧓 who was convicted 🔨 back in 1996 for the brutal MURDER 🔪 of Colleen Slemmer is now PAUSED ⏸️ while judges from the Sixth Circuit Appeals Court 🏛️ demand MORE ⏳ time to chew 🦷 on her latest ARGUMENTS 🗣️!! If this thing PROCEEDS 🚶‍♀️ she would have been the FIRST 👆 woman executed in Tennessee in over TWO HUNDRED 🕳️ YEARS 📅 which is WILD 🌪️ bro!! Her lawyers 👩‍⚖️ are claiming the state flipped FLOPPED 🙃 on whether they believe she suffered CHILDHOOD 🧸 sexual ABUSE 🩹 and RAPE 😣 so the whole federal review is now COMPROMISED 🧩!! "We will continue to advocate for the lawfully imposed sentence as the courts work through this technical issue" said the Attorney General while secretly hoping the Supreme Court lifts this STAY 🛏️ quick!!

Pike was only EIGHTEEN 🧑‍🦰 when she and her then-boyfriend Tadaryl Shipp BEAT 🥊 TORTURED 🪚 and MURDERED ☠️ 19-year-old Colleen Slemmer whom they met at a troubled TEENS 🏕️ job training CAMP ⛺!! The killing created a MEDIA 📺 frenzy in Knoxville when the victim was found with a PENTAGRAM 🕉️ carved into her CHEST 🫀 and Pike has always DENIED 🙅‍♀️ doing the carving herself!! She accused Slemmer of INSULTING 🗣️ her and trying to STEAL 💔 her boyfriend while two other camp residents TESTIFIED 📜 that Pike BRAGGED 🗣️ about the murder before AND after and even showed them a PIECE 🦴 of Slemmer's SKULL 🦇!! A year later Pike got the DEATH 💀 sentence while Shipp who was SEVENTEEN 🧔‍♂️ at the time received LIFE 🧬 with parole POSSIBILITY 🔓!!

This latest RULING 📜 comes after the Supreme Court already DENIED ❌ a reprieve and the Tennessee governor said NO 🙅 to clemency earlier this WEEK 📅!! Pike has a documented HISTORY 📖 of childhood sexual ABUSE 🩸 abandonment and NEGLECT 😔 so her legal team believes if she was tried TODAY 📆 as a teenager she would NOT ❌ be staring down the LETHAL 🍆 INJECTION 💉!! Last year Tennessee's own Supreme Court ruled she had NOT shown enough circumstances to justify COMMUTING 🚫 her sentence which left her lawyers DOWN BAD 😩!! At the time of her INCARCERATION ⛓️ Pike was the YOUNGEST 👶 person on death row according to the Tennessee Department of Corrections which is honestly WILD 🌪️ when you think about it!!

Her appeal that triggered Wednesday's dramatic STAY 🛑 is completely different from the one the Supreme Court REFUSED 🚫 to even HEAR 👂!! This one focuses on Tennessee's LETHAL INJECTION 💉 METHOD 🧪 which her lawyers argue could cause SUFFERING 😣 way beyond what the Constitution allows and that the state's PROCEDURES 📋 denied her a FAIR 🎲 chance to PROVE 🧪 it!! The state had spent YEARS 🕰️ in court claiming Pike LIED 🤥 about being sexually abused as a CHILD 🧒 but then at a recent hearing about the execution METHOD they suddenly said they do NOT dispute she suffered ABUSE 🩹 and RAPE 😣 which is the plot TWIST 🌀 her team is riding!! "We are asking the Supreme Court of the United States to lift the stay" the Attorney General added while the clock keeps TICKING ⏰ on this never-ending legal EDGING 🫦!!

The murder itself happened in 1995 and created absolute CHAOS 🌩️ in Knoxville with the satanic SYMBOL 🕯️ carved into the victim's chest sending everyone into a MEDIA 📻 frenzy!! Pike has maintained she did NOT carve that PENTAGRAM 🪬 herself but the testimony from other residents about her BRAGGING 🦜 before and after the killing including showing off a chunk of SKULL 🦴 painted a pretty GRIM 🪦 picture for the jury!! Her lawyers keep stressing that with her background of ABUSE 🩹 and neglect a modern court would likely spare her the DEATH 💀 penalty which makes this whole situation feel like it's stuck in a TIME 🕰️ LOOP ♻️!! Tennessee officials are cooked if they think this technical issue will just magically disappear but the Attorney General is still pushing hard to get that STAY 🛏️ lifted so justice can finally be SERVED 🍽️!!
